intro: Witch Doctor Uzer'i needs a concoction that Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has mixed up. Uzer'i hands you a shrunken head, promised to Neeru in exchange for the herbs, and sends you to the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar to deliver it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has what I need to get started here! He has mixed up a concoction that I need for my... Well, you'll see.

Off with you now -- to Orgrimmar. Here, take this with you. It's a shrunken head that I promised Neeru in exchange for the herbs. It's the head of some poor dwarf I ventured across in the forest. I'm sure Neeru will be pleased.
You'll find Neeru in the Cleft of Shadow.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have been waiting for Uzer'i to deliver this...
Let me give you the herb mixture I prepared for his... Well, experiments...
